summary: ZTO Express (Cayman) Inc. filed a Form 6-K with two Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Returns detailing share buybacks. On August 12, 2026, the company repurchased 73,128 American depositary shares at USD 22.98 per ADS, and on August 13, 2026, repurchased 218,268 ADSs at USD 22.89 per ADS, representing 0.03% of issued shares combined. The buybacks were made on the open market and not cancelled as of the closing balance date. The company has 763,430,906 total issued shares. Watch for continued repurchases and potential impact on share price.
